_note: Thai names vplay uses for gear the set rosters do not cover. Each was found in a cached vplay post (cache/th_view_*.html) or a page one links to (cache/th_link_*.html), or in another vplay post category read through its WordPress API (/wp-json/wp/v2/posts) -- 'ชั้นดี' is the middle Four Holy Beasts tier (Aural/Flame/Shiny/Radiant): the 2019-05-27 Thai patch note's per-boss sealed accessory drops match dmowiki Clothing's How to Obtain boss for boss (sub-bosses give the plain tier, the beast's own box gives ชั้นดี / Shiny); a name seen only as a box (กล่อง...) is the box's single piece. Duration and level tails ([30 วัน], [Lv.5]) are dropped unless the English name carries one. Read by builders/build_gear_registry.py.

_inferred_note: Names vplay never prints (full-text search of every post found none), built by the owner's call from vplay's own pattern: the middle tier (Aural/Flame/Shiny/Radiant) as '<piece>ชั้นดีของ<beast>' like Baihumon Aural Gloves, the plain tier as '<piece>ของ<beast>'. The rest borrow vplay's own words where it has them: tiers as '<piece> : ขั้นสูง' / 'พื้นฐาน' (its mask boxes; Crude/Inferior have no vplay word, so ชั้นต่ำ/ชั้นรอง), Power/Unlimited transliterated as vplay does (พาวเวอร์, อันลิมิเต็ด), 'ทะเลทรายที่เปล่งประกาย' from its desert coin, 'รอยัลไนท์', and XAI kept in English like 'XAI Ver IV'. Durations as '[N วัน]', Permanent '[ถาวร]'. Pages mark them as inferred; a vplay sighting moves the pair up into items.
